svg.text: Before v2.6.0: the box the equal-count cut gives, as one piece grows
Bins are 16 x 4 fine grid points and run x fastest, so one piece is a contiguous run of bins.
min x and max x sit at
(a) needs nb above the bin row count. (b) is what nb from the thread count or the point cap gives at
any grid worth tiling, and (c) is one piece per row boundary. No run of 16 x 4 bins is square, so the
cubic box is the thing the bin order cannot give: that is what the tiled cut adds.
